results.title: Scorch Marks
results.overview: Waking up to a scorched sky, Beckett fears he is the lone survivor of a sudden global catastrophe. Stranded and isolated inside a seaside rental property, his remaining grip on reality rapidly unravels when he is confronted by a terrifying presence—the vengeful spirit of Joel, his abusive ex-husband. To survive both the unfolding global apocalypse and the primordial forces awakening around them, the estranged pair must directly confront the toxic, destructive history of their past life within high society.

results.title: Castration Movie Expansion Pack i. You're Weird, But I Love You!
results.original_title: Castration Movie Expansion Pack i. You're Weird, But I Love You!
results.overview: A feature-length deleted scenes movie from the Blu-ray release of the anthology series Castration Movie.

results.title: National Theatre at Home: War Horse
results.original_title: National Theatre at Home: War Horse
results.overview: At the outbreak of the First World War, young Albert's beloved horse Joey is sold to the cavalry and shipped to France. Too young to enlist, Albert refuses to forget him, embarking on an extraordinary journey from the fields of rural Devon to the trenches of wartime France – determined to bring Joey home. Based on Michael Morpurgo's beloved novel, War Horse is a timeless story of love, courage and friendship, brought to life by astonishing life-sized horses from Handspring Puppet Company and a stirring musical score. Following a sell-out national tour, the Tony Award–winning global sensation returns to where it all began, nearly two decades after its debut at the National Theatre for this 2026 revival production.

results.title: Odyssey
results.overview: What if the United States hadn't pulled the plug on Apollo, as Apple's FOR ALL MANKIND imagined? Built from 2,500 hours of restored archival footage, director Avi Belkin masterfully constructs a riveting thriller around the fateful Apollo 13 mission. Unfolding through the intimate perspective of astronaut Jim Lovell and his family, ODYSSEY tracks his lunar dreams to that distressing message: "Houston, we've had a problem."

results.title: Robyn – From Child Star to Global Star
results.overview: She made her breakthrough as a teenager and quickly became one of Sweden’s biggest pop stars. Since then, Robyn has followed her own path, building an international career on her own terms. Yet, behind the success lies a story of pressure, self-doubt, and the quest for self-discovery. This is the story of Robyn—from teenage idol to pop icon.

results.title: Trauma or, Monsters All
results.overview: An aspiring author gets more than she bargained for when she writes an article for the local paper about her small town’s dark history, prompting unwanted speculation on what monsters may lie within.

results.title: Worst Behavior
results.overview: An LGBTQ+ coming-of-age drama about the emotional isolation and recklessness of Gen Z.The story follows Julie, a young woman trapped in the chaos of modern "situationships." While trying to rekindle a complex romance with her former flame, Noa, her friends pressure her to move on and ask another woman, Erin, out on a date. Lost between peer advice and group dynamics, Julie spirals into poor communication and impulsive choices.Filmed in Bar Harbor, Maine, the short film captures the raw contradictions of a youth that is hyper-connected by technology but deeply isolated in its feelings.

results.title: A Few Things Happening by a River
results.original_title: Algumas Coisas que Acontecem ao Lado de Um Rio
results.overview: A group of teenagers floats down the river, pretending to be dead for social media. One of them drifts away.

results.title: Calçada Perra
results.overview: A girl walks through various spaces searching for her memory through a single possession, a Polaroid picture she finds in her pockets. During her journey, she asks for help from several people who exhibit atypical behavior.

results.title: Green Noise
results.overview: Welcome to the Office of Development in Krabstadt, a small Arctic town where the Nordic countries have sent a group of unwanted citizens. One day, the bureaucrats KK and Schlop Schlop are taken aback when the office’s IKEA plants grow tired of the humans and start chanting, “Fight, fight, plants unite!” An absurd and humorous take on sustainable growth, climate activism, and public art.

results.title: As Far Back As I Can Remember... The Story of Goodfellas
results.original_title: As Far Back As I Can Remember... The Story of Goodfellas
results.overview: The ultimate love letter to Martin Scorsese's classic film GoodFellas (1990).

results.title: Halima
results.overview: Halima lives on Morocco’s coast and makes a living by gathering and selling mussels. An unknown phone call brings her long-buried past back to light.  After her husband passed away, Halima stayed alone in their old house in the mountains. The land is undergoing drastic changes, leaving her home, livelihood and sense of belonging all precarious. Grief, hardship and displacement follow one after another. Though fate knocks her down time and again, she never surrenders.A former photojournalist, the director captures this one-woman battle with stark cinematography. Free from grand outcries, the film lays bare her everyday resilience. Amid constant flux and loss, this woman stands firm, striving to carve out her own place in the world.

results.title: TRAD
results.overview: From their home in the Donegal Gaeltacht, gifted fiddle player Shóna McAnally and her little brother Mickey take to the road with a troupe of wandering musicians, on a cross-country journey of adventure, romance, and musical exploration.

results.title: Isabel Hagen at the Bitter End
results.original_title: Isabel Hagen at the Bitter End
results.overview: Comedian and violist Isabel Hagen tells sharp jokes about being a musician, anxiety and death, and eventually blending it with classical viola playing.

results.title: At the Sea
results.overview: After a long rehabilitation, Laura returns to her family at their beach holiday home where she has to readjust to the complicated life she left behind. Now she is forced to face the following next chapter of her life without the career that gave her fame, fortune and, most importantly, identity.

results.title: The Almajiri
results.overview: In the ancient city of Kano, a gifted almajiri defies poverty and dogma in pursuit of education, risking everything to become a tech engineer. Raised on scripture and survival, Rabiu's extraordinary mind cannot stay hidden. When a teacher sees his genius and fights for his future, he must choose between the only world he knows and the one he was born to build.

results.title: Don Chisciotte
results.overview: Wounded at the Battle of Lepanto and recoverying in a Messina hospital, Miguel de Cervantes experiences a vision amidst fever and hallucinations. From the flames of burning books, Don Alonso Quijano is born—a man driven mad by tales of chivalry who transforms into the knight-errant Don Quixote.  Accompanied by the simple Sancho Panza, lured by the promise of an island to rule, Quixote embarks on a quest where inns become castles and windmills turn into giants. Despite the cruel mockery of bored nobles and a series of crushing defeats, his madness reveals a disarming purity: he fights solely for justice and freedom, even as the world laughs.  Betrayed and humiliated, he is eventually brought home in a cage, unable to survive without his ideals. As he dies, the scene shifts back to the Sicilian night: from the pain of war, Cervantes has forged a masterpiece—the stubborn dream of a more liberated humanity.

results.title: Emily
results.overview: Following the steps of an ancient ritual, Michael is granted entry to a mysterious temple. Inside, he attempts to bring his lost love back to life.
